Decisions on your three stopped clusters; do them as further commits on qs13r4-coverage.

The conversion follows AGENTS.md's stack-safety rule and no product query reaches the walker with decorated roots (they are refused). Say so in that commit's message if it does not already; no further test.

A definition never exits the enclosing loop. Change the condition so scope nodes are skipped even at the root (`scope_kind(current).is_some()` always skips; the loop-kind skip keeps the `current.id() != node.id()` root exemption as it is). Restore your nested-loop regression: the nested def containing `return` followed by an unconditional reassignment must give nested_loop_reused=false, with your conditional break/continue/return controls and the inner-loop break control that did not run. Tag it #[hardwon("<12-char hash>: a nested function's return counted as a loop exit")] with the commit that introduced the root exemption (git log -S), and save the fail-before log.
